groups.group: Metal admission, numerical runtime and CLI

cases: Both previously failing high-arity CLI gates now run in -O0, -O2, ASan/UBSan and TSan host modes with 1/2/4 workers

Numerical direct/indirect argument harnesses run on Metal in normal and ASan/UBSan host builds, retaining CPU/GPU/APFloat comparisons, immutable/cached ownership, CPU/Metal allocation failures, byte/admission limits, cancellation/deadlines and pending-core teardown

All four recursive-callable host modes preserve owned results/errors, all numeric widths, deep-recursion CallLimitFault and balanced cleanup, and oversized native frame rejection without output replacement
Forty outlined unary/binary operations return the expected result and handle empty input in four host modes; each helper carries noinline and checked-call machinery
Returned closure/function-pointer choices retain the final checked ABI after simplification; existing function values, closures, block closures and function arrays run in normal/sanitized host modes
Records, String fields and enums run in normal/sanitized modes under the shared data-layout-aware simplification
Relocated Release CPU/Metal bundle retains numerical library private versions, frozen/offline cache restoration and compiler/source-independent generated applications

limits: Outlining currently targets float32 tensor unary/binary operations; other large-function and large-argument shapes remain subject to ordinary resource admission
Helper boundaries may change generated code size, allocation counts or execution overhead; no performance improvement is claimed
This repair does not expand GPU numeric types, ranks, scalar-only entries, shader control flow or fused reduction/matmul graphs
Host sanitizer and actual Metal execution qualification is on one Apple M2 Max/macOS ARM64; shader instructions and third-party LLVM/frameworks are not sanitizer instrumented
